entities.summary: Chris Dowe is an American professional basketball player who last played for Pallacanestro Brescia of Lega Basket Serie A. He played college basketball for Bellarmine University before playing professionally in Portugal, France, Belgium and Israel. Standing at 6 ft 3 in (1.91 m), he primarily plays at the shooting guard position.
